svg.title: Four scenarios for scoped DPP convergence
svg.desc: Four scenarios for scoped DPP convergence Prospective scenarios | unit of analysis: one specified exchange and receiving decision INSTITUTIONAL RECOGNITION FOR THE SPECIFIED OPERATION Stronger recognition Recognised networks Recognised partners and assessors; manual exchange or version matching still constrains reuse. Federated evidence corridors A bounded technical profile and scoped acceptance of issuers, methods, mandates and access. Limited recognition Fragmented compliance Separate records, manual mapping and repeated onboarding; similar labels may carry different meanings. Connected evidence Evidence can be transferred and verified; authority, method or acceptance remains unresolved. Limited Stronger DEMONSTRATED TECHNICAL INTEROPERABILITY No probabilities, country positions, measured scores or automatic progression are implied.

rdf:Alt.rdf:li: Four scenarios for scoped DPP convergence

Four scenarios cross demonstrated technical interoperability with institutional recognition for one specified operation. Prospective scenarios: fragmented compliance, connected evidence, recognised networks and federated evidence corridors. No probabilities, measured country positions or automatic progression are implied. One ecosystem may occupy different scenarios for different workflows. Paper Figure 7, page 42.
